system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: any swamps. Deepmire lily floats upon black swamp water, anchored by a thick white bulb buried far below the mud. Its waxy flower smells faintly of clean linen, making a blooming patch conspicuous even amid stagnant pools. The bulb contains a powerful restorative sap that is pressed, filtered and drunk in a single bitter measure. Reduce your Fatigued condition by 1. You cannot benefit from Deepmire Lily again until you complete a Full Rest. On the sheet: You cannot benefit from Deepmire Lily again until you complete a Full Rest. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
